botcomponent.description: Resolve teams from the standard Dataverse team table. Use it to turn the GUID in _faf001_assignedteam_value into a team name and description. Filter with teamid eq <guid>, or use an actual team name supplied by the user; do not assume a predefined team name. Useful columns: teamid, name, description, teamtype, _administratorid_value. Always pass $select and $top.
botcomponent.name: List team rows
